SELECT ba.batch_id as batchId, ba.preferential_type as preferentialType, ba.free_rent_periods as freeRentPeriods, DATE_FORMAT(ba.entry_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as entryStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(ba.entry_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as entryEndDate FROM hz_batch_house bh INNER JOIN hz_batch_allocation ba ON bh.batch_id = ba.batch_id WHERE bh.house_id = #{houseId} AND bh.del_flag = '0' AND ba.del_flag = '0' AND ba.approve_status = '1'
AND (ba.batch_status IS NULL OR ba.batch_status <> '2') ORDER BY ba.batch_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ba.batch_id as batchId, ba.preferential_type as preferentialType, ba.free_rent_periods as freeRentPeriods, DATE_FORMAT(ba.entry_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as entryStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(ba.entry_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as entryEndDate FROM hz_batch_house bh INNER JOIN hz_batch_allocation ba ON bh.batch_id = ba.batch_id INNER JOIN hz_batch_tenant bt ON bt.id = bh.tenant_id WHERE bh.house_id = #{houseId} AND bh.del_flag = '0' AND ba.del_flag = '0' AND ba.approve_status = '1' AND (ba.batch_status IS NULL OR ba.batch_status <> '2') AND bt.del_flag = '0' AND bt.id_card = #{idCard} ORDER BY ba.batch_id DESC LIMIT 1
